Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long‑weekend holidays that actually give you a three‑day break in Canada in 2023**.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a weekday, so you get the adjacent weekend days off.  Holidays that land on a weekend or a weekday that isn’t a holiday do **not** create a long weekend.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Province(s) where it’s a statutory holiday | Long‑weekend span |
|-------------|---------|-------------------------------------------|-------------------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day | Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island | **Feb 18–20** (Mon‑Wed) |
| **Apr 7**  | Good Friday | All provinces except Quebec (Quebec has its own “Good Friday” holiday) | **Apr 7–9** (Fri‑Sun) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | All provinces & territories | **May 20–22** (Mon‑Wed) |
| **Sep 4**  | Labour Day | All provinces & territories | **Sep 2–4** (Mon‑Wed) |
| **Oct 9**  | Thanksgiving | All provinces & territories | **Oct 7–9** (Mon‑Wed) |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | All provinces & territories | **Dec 23–25** (Mon‑Wed) |

### Quick notes

| Holiday | 2023 Observance | Why it *does* create a long weekend |
|---------|-----------------|-------------------------------------|
| **Family Day** | Feb 20 (Mon) | Adjacent weekend (Feb 18‑19) |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Fri) | Adjacent weekend (Apr 8‑9) |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Mon) | Adjacent weekend (May 20‑21) |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Mon) | Adjacent weekend (Sep 2‑3) |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Mon) | Adjacent weekend (Oct 7‑8) |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Mon) | Adjacent weekend (Dec 23‑24) |

### Holidays that *don’t* give a long weekend in 2023

| Holiday | 2023 Observance | Reason |
|---------|-----------------|--------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sun) | Already a weekend |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Sat) | Already a weekend |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Sat) | Already a weekend |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tue) | Falls on a weekday but not adjacent to a weekend holiday |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> If you want to support *province‑specific* long weekends, you’ll need to keep a mapping of which holidays apply in each province/territory. The table above covers the federal holidays that create long weekends nationwide; the rest are province‑specific and can be added as needed.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the full list of all statutory holidays (including those that don’t create long weekends) or province‑specific details!
